u0055 (fs100 ROS driver at 8d77063, producer of JointTrajPtFull): grep -rni 'isremote' over snapshot/fs100/src and snapshot/fs100/include returns no matches — the producer contains no code that grants or sets the controller's REMOTE mode. Its only 'remote'-related lines are observational: fs100/src/simple_message/motoman_motion_reply.cpp:146-147 "case MotionReplySubcodes::NotReady::NOT_REMOTE:" / "	  return \"Controller not in REMOTE mode\";" — parsing the reply subcode the consumer returns when the permission is missing. Absence of a producer grant is supported.

u0053 snapshot/fs100/MotoPlus: exhaustive grep for 'IsRemote' finds only Controller.c:62 (forward declaration), Controller.c:325 (definition reading ioStatus), Controller.c:376 and :491 and MotionServer.c:447 (checks), Controller.h:117 (extern) — every occurrence is a declaration or a check; none grants remote mode. The REMOTE state is an external controller input refreshed by Ros_Controller_StatusRead (Controller.c:129 "Ros_Controller_StatusRead(controller, controller->ioStatus);") from IO address 50056, and the only IO write in the snapshot is Ros_Controller_SetIOState (Controller.c:532-544, "void Ros_Controller_SetIOState(ULONG signal, BOOL status)" ... "ret = mpWriteIO(&ioData, 1);" writing a caller-specified feedback signal) — nothing writes the REMOTE input, so the consumer's perm_grants absence is supported: MotoROS can only require and observe this permission, never grant it.

notes: The item's evidence.provenance is null for all three trigger paths; I resolved the locations from the referenced assembled file (producer/consumer port provenance) and by exhaustive grep enumeration in the two snapshots, then opened each cited file. All three values verified, including both absence claims (producer and consumer perm_grants) via complete occurrence inventories. Recorded observations, not disagreements: (1) The permission Ros_Controller_IsRemote(controller) is a standing controller-side safety gate in the MotoROS code (present in this resolved revision), while the case's documented failure per specs/robust_292b5cc.json is invalid sequence/robot_id fields in MOTO_MOTION_CTRL replies, fixed by consumer-side commit 292b5cc; the perm finding's relation to that documented failure is a method-level question outside evidence adjudication. (2) The two encodings transcribe the same physical units differently (producer 'time: s; pos: rad; vel: rad/s; acc: rad/s^2' vs consumer 'time: seconds; pos: radian; vel: radian/sec; acc: radian/sec^2', the latter matching fs100/MotoPlus/SimpleMessage.h:105-108 comments) — a transcription difference, and not a trigger value for this finding.
